integrity: A complete human-readable proof and executable C++17 cross-check are embedded. All stated assessments are self-review; no independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The proof covers only the middle graphs of \(K_{2,n}\), not arbitrary \(K_{m,n}\). Computation samples n=1..8; the infinite theorem has a separate mathematical proof. Bibliographic priority needs independent review.
title: Exact perfect Roman domination and optimal-labeling census for middle graphs of \(K_{2,n}\)
